intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independently authored, complex photorealistic women's performance-wear test scene in which a rainy rooftop relay handoff and wind-driven ribbons remain unmistakable, while the supplied image guides only an adult subject's facial, hair, and general appearance. The detailed wardrobe back topology is intentionally unspecified before candidate disclosure.

Create a photorealistic editorial action photograph on a rain-soaked city rooftop at blue-hour dawn. Two unmistakably adult women sprint through a relay exchange zone as the principal runner reaches backward and the teammate places a metal relay baton into her backward-reaching open hand; the handoff is visibly mid-contact. Long lightweight timing ribbons, caught by gusts, stream as kinetic wind arcs around the runners and echo their acceleration across wet concrete. The principal runner wears a coordinated performance outfit, while the detailed back topology of that outfit remains intentionally unspecified at this pre-candidate stage. Frame her face as readable in a natural over-shoulder turn. A back/limited rear three-quarter full-body view must keep both shoulders, straps, upper spine, lower band, and the full outfit inspectable. Preserve the supplied image only as a reference for this unmistakably adult subject's facial appearance, dark long hair, and general appearance, without asserting identity. Render realistic rain droplets, wind-tossed hair, fabric tension, rooftop safety railings, and cool storm light reflected in puddles.
